System Communication Matrix & Telemetry Pipeline Protocols
• 4-20mA pressure transducer samples hydrostatic liquid column every 1.0s
• FreeRTOS moving-average filter suppresses sloshing & mechanical vibration
• Quectel EC200U transmits MQTT payload via cellular 4G LTE AT+QMTPUB
• Topic namespace: panorama/{train_id}/telemetry with QoS 1 persistence
• 48Ah LiFePO4 battery budget supports up to 6 months unpowered transit
• Async MQTT daemon ingests messages and validates schema against Pydantic v2
• Automated 60-second telemetry timeout engine updates online/offline state
• 4-State Level Engine evaluates Critically Low (<10%), Low, Normal & Full
• SQLite WAL connection pool handles concurrent writes without thread lock
• FastAPI REST endpoints expose JWT-secured train, coach and tank fleet data
• Direct WebSocket MQTT client streams real-time telemetry into React Context
• Pure status service (tankStatusService.ts) computes online tank counters
• Responsive UI token system adapts fluidly to mobile (390px) and desktop (1080p)
• Electron 30 runtime isolates renderer and supervises local Python daemon
• Static HTML/JS deployable to edge CDN (GitHub Pages) with remote WSS
